connect_pairing_subtitle: Connect the scooter to an account
connect_pairing_intro: Connect this scooter to a supported online service. Choose and confirm the account on the Connect website.
connect_pairing_confirm_body: Pairing will start for {scooter}. Available scooter identifiers (IMEI, ICCID and serial number) are sent to Librescoot Connect. You will choose the service and confirm the account connection on the website.
connect_pairing_disconnected: Connect to the scooter over Bluetooth first.
connect_pairing_unsupported: This scooter's firmware does not yet support pairing over Bluetooth.
connect_pairing_error: Could not read or change pairing status. Check the connection and scooter, then try again.
connect_pairing_code_help: Open Connect to prefill the code, or copy it if needed. Sign in to your chosen service and confirm the scooter and your account there.
connect_pairing_open_error: Could not open Connect. Open https://connect.librescoot.org/pair in your browser.
connect_pairing_state_not_registered: Pairing has not been started for this scooter.
connect_pairing_state_registered: The scooter is registered. Start pairing to get a code.
connect_pairing_state_waiting_for_web_se: Waiting for your confirmation in the browser.
connect_pairing_state_applying: The scooter is setting up the connection...
connect_pairing_state_connected: The scooter is connected to the account.
connect_pairing_state_error: Pairing failed. Check that the scooter is safely parked and online, then try again.
connect_pairing_state_paused: Pairing is paused. You can start it again.
sms_forwarding_description: Forward new messages to this number. Carrier charges may apply. Forwarding is limited to 10 SMS segments per day and is disabled while roaming.
sms_unsupported: Messages are not supported by this scooter firmware.
sms_read_error: Could not read messages. Check the Bluetooth connection.
sms_connect: Connect to the scooter to read messages.
onboarding_step6_body: Give your scooter a name and pick a colour.
seat_alert_body: The seatbox is open. “Lock anyways” sends two ordinary lock requests. Older firmware may still wait about 30 seconds, then take about 5 seconds to shut down.
home_lock_request_sent: Lock requests sent. Check the scooter’s status.
home_lock_request_incomplete: Lock request sequence incomplete. The first request may already have started waiting or shutdown. Check the scooter’s status; no request was replayed.
handlebar_lock_waiting: Turn the handlebars fully left while the scooter shuts down. The steering lock has a limited positioning window; there is no need to switch the scooter off and on again. Check the lock status on the scooter.
system_info_failed: Could not read versions. Check the connection and try again.
settings_scooter_disconnected: Connect to the scooter to use this setting.
ls_settings_firmware_unavailable: Not available on this scooter's firmware.

ride.cached_data: Offline — showing the latest saved ride data.

trip_reset_confirm_body: This resets the current trip counter on your scooter. It does not delete trip history.
trip_disconnected: Connect to the scooter to view the trip counter.
trip_unsupported: This scooter does not support a trip counter.
trip_timeout: The scooter did not answer in time.
trip_error: Could not load the trip counter.
trip_retention_invalid_age: Enter a positive duration, such as 168h or 365d.
trip_retention_invalid_number: Enter a whole number from 0 to 9223372036854775807.
trip_retention_unsupported: This scooter does not support history retention.
file_browser_replace_body: Replace {name} ({size})? The current file is replaced only if unchanged. Uploads here can affect services that use these files.
file_browser_debug_only: The Bluetooth file browser is available only in debug and profile builds.
file_browser_logs_unavailable: Connect to a scooter with the Bluetooth file tunnel to browse Logs.
file_browser_data_opt_in: Whole /data browsing is unavailable. It requires the scooter-side --enable-data-browser administrative opt-in. Logs remain available above.
